stories.title: Vietnam's Q3 GDP growth reaches 9.95%
stories.summary: Vietnam's economy expanded 9.95% year over year in the third quarter, its fastest quarterly growth in four years, supported by strong exports and infrastructure investment.
stories.why: The acceleration is a major signal for Vietnam's economy and could affect investment, inflation, rates, and the full-year growth outlook.

stories.title: Norway plans a temporary ban on AI glasses in some public places
stories.summary: Norway's government said it plans to propose a temporary ban on AI glasses in selected public places as lawmakers respond to privacy and misuse concerns around increasingly capable wearable AI devices.
stories.why: This is an early example of governments moving from general AI rules toward restrictions on a specific consumer hardware category.

stories.title: Gears of War: E-Day launches October 6 on Xbox and PC
stories.summary: Microsoft's next major Gears release arrives October 6 for Xbox Series X|S and PC, with Game Pass and Xbox Play Anywhere support.
stories.why: It is one of October's biggest releases and a major test for Xbox's first-party lineup after a turbulent year for its gaming business.

stories.title: NVIDIA publishes new Wayland vs. X.Org latency testing
stories.summary: NVIDIA presented latency measurements comparing Wayland and X.Org at XDC 2026 while also discussing its Display Config Server work for Linux display management.
stories.why: Wayland latency and NVIDIA behavior remain especially relevant for Linux gaming and desktop users, and the testing gives more concrete data on the transition away from X.Org.

stories.title: NASA studies thunderstorm-like clouds spawned by intense wildfires
stories.summary: NASA's INSPYRE campaign collected aircraft and ground measurements of pyrocumulonimbus clouds, which can inject wildfire smoke tens of thousands of feet into the atmosphere and even into the stratosphere.
stories.why: Understanding these fire-generated storms could improve wildfire forecasting and climate models by showing how extreme fires reshape weather and transport smoke.
